mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_code_group ( code_group_id, group_code, group_name, description, use_yn, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{codeGroupId}, #{groupCode}, #{groupName}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{useYn},'Y'), 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_code_group SET group_code=#{groupCode}, group_name=#{groupName}, description=#{description}, use_yn=COALESCE(#{useYn}, use_yn), updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_ip=#{updatedIp}, updated_at=COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE code_group_id = #{codeGroupId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_code_group WHERE delete_yn = 'Y' AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
